QuestInfo.1: The time has come for your last class! Now you must learn the head-over-heels expression... You can learn it from #b#p2152001##k in #b#m310000000##k. #p1052121# seems to have a lot of concerns these days. Find out what happened.

0.0: ...No, that's no good... If only Blake would get his act together, but no, he's B-list for now... What to do, what to do? Money...or conscience... And after I put so much effort into this new...
0.1: Ah, when did you get here? Don't sneak up on me like that! Ha... I'm sorry, I'm just on edge lately. Um, personal issues...yes. Nothing to do with you, not at all. Next class now please?

yes.0: Okay, welcome to your final lesson! Today, you will learn to fall in love... Do I need to explain how that looks?
yes.1: There is a man in #b#m310000000##k who has fallen in love. I believe his name is #b#p2152001##k. Go to #m310000000# and learn how to express the feeling of love from #p2152001#.

no.0: That's okay. I'm not sure what else to teach you, anyway.

1.0: Huh? You're not one of my students, are you...? You want to know who I love...? Obviously I love Leonore of the Black Wings. We're, er, not together yet, but it won't be long before I win her over.
